title: No file of the tools, skills or docs names the autopilot, and the docs say what sprints with several sessions need
goal: A sweep after the removals: git grep -il autopilot over _tools, .claude, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and kb/_self (outside kb/_self/_decisions.csv and the backlog item files, which are history) finds nothing; map.csv rows, README.md, plugin.md and maintaining.md skill tables name no removed file or skill; the selfdoc map and cohesion checks pass; and kb/_self/backlog.md gains one short section for sprints run by several sessions: a claim is per item and per task, never per story that spans a sprint's files; the dispatch brief a runner needs (item id and title, touches checked against held, KB_TEST_WORKERS, memory pause); the overlap policy (docs exception, different regions, facade files); save a failing gate's text to a new file before retrying.

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run(['git','grep','-il','autopilot','--','_tools','.claude','AGENTS.md','CLAUDE.md','kb/_self',':!kb/_self/_decisions.csv',':!kb/_self/backlog/'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip(); sys.exit(1 if o else 0)

notes: Order: runs last of the sprint (after the three removals land); no depends_on because a docs-only task may not depend on the code whose docs it sweeps.
